observed_result.comparisons_against_normal: Paired by seed, 1000 resamples, 95%: frozen_core success +0.150 [+0.050, +0.300], agreement +0.294 [+0.035, +0.452]; core_only +0.067 [0, +0.150], +0.006 [-0.238, +0.210]; generic_matched +0.050 [0, +0.100], +0.083 [+0.033, +0.182]; rewired 0 [0, 0], +0.168 [0, +0.254]; ablated_retrained +0.167 [+0.100, +0.200], +0.354 [+0.144, +0.479]; capacity_matched_modulator +0.117 [+0.050, +0.150], +0.314 [+0.146, +0.399]. Every per-seed difference is at least 0 except core_only's agreement on seed 2 (-0.238).
observed_result.reading: The positive differences mostly reflect a weak baseline: normal trains the core weights and the encoder together, its activity rises from 0.25 to 0.93, its unseen success is 0 on all three seeds and its agreement 0.091, the lowest of the seven groups. The TSK-08 recurrent policy on the same task, seeds and schedule, which is the same model with the encoder frozen, reached unseen agreement 0.367 (evidence/TSK-08). So this run shows no drop after freezing or removing the core and supports no claim of dependence on the core or of any wiring being better. The report carries only the fixed conclusion sentence of master plan 14.4.
observed_result.rewire_checks: The three rewired runs report degrees_kept true, duplicates 0, self_loops_after 0, direction_kept true and readout_reachable true, with 279, 318 and 289 of 640 swaps accepted; the fixture's edges carry no sign, as the assumptions state.
observed_result.core_only_checks: On seeds 1 and 2 core_only's seen agreement did not rise (0.053 to 0.044 and 0.210 to 0.013), so the report attaches the five checks: every readout node reachable from the inputs, a core weight displacement of 10.65 and 10.76, mean |input| 0.251 and mean |action readout| 0.717 and 0.911 with neither saturated nor vanishing, state reset bit-identical, and a policy that receives only the observation prefix. Seed 3 learned (0.110 to 0.157) and carries no checks. No code path enlarges the periphery.
observed_result.conclusion: A drop after freezing or removing the core shows dependence on it, not that the original wiring is superior.
observed_result.reproducibility: A second run at c8433c3 under a different machine load produced byte-identical attribution.json and summary.txt.

assumption_statement: The core is the navigation policy's random sparse recurrent block, not the fly connectome; the matrix shows that every control runs under one schedule and reports its parameters and budget, not which wiring is better. ablated_retrained and capacity_matched_modulator report their parameter counts rather than matching them.
limitations: The normal baseline did not learn under the pre-registered learning rate 0.05 once the encoder trains with the core, so the comparisons say little about the core's contribution. Choosing a rate or per-group rates would need a new pre-registration on other seeds before rerunning seeds 1 to 3 (AGENTS.md follow-up).
Three seeds give wide intervals; a success difference of 0.05 is one evaluation episode per seed.
Fixture scale only (9x9 maps, 16 hidden nodes, 60 episodes); not the fly connectome.
The report's config.env stores zero fields that nav2d.New replaces with defaults (AGENTS.md follow-up).
